newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks extend losses at Monday's open.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks extend losses at Monday's open.

text.p: * Toronto stocks extended Friday's losses in thin trading at Monday's open, but Wall Street rebounded slightly. * All sectors fell. * 5 million shares traded worth C$76 million.
Analysts believe that the Federal Open Market Committee will keep short-term interest rates unchanged.
Ram added that Friday's drop is likely the start of a longer weakness after weeks of record-setting gains. "We all know this is healthy."
All 14 of Toronto's sub-indexes shed points, led by forestry products, conglomerates, utilities and golds.
Declining issues outnumbered advances 281 to 163 while 195 traded flat.
* BCE Inc, Canada's largest publicly traded firm, dropped 0.65
* Royal Bank of Canada bucked the trend to weakness, rising 0.05
